name: r5_bound_repair_033
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd();s=(p/'src/URMatchingAvoidanceBound.lean').read_text();s=s.replace('  simpa only [Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_comm (N - A.card).factorial,\n    ← Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.factorial_mul_descFactorial haN] using hh','  have he : N.descFactorial A.card * (N - A.card).factorial = N.factorial := by\n    rw [Nat.mul_comm, Nat.factorial_mul_descFactorial haN]\n  simpa only [Nat.mul_assoc, he] using hh')
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'src/URMatchingAvoidanceBound.lean'],input=s,text=True,check=True)
